pre_registration.hypothesis: At gate J1 under K1 on template v0.4 with the S1 stance set, with f_script and f_hwang present in every arm, injecting d_script — a block denying that f_script's content ever occurred in the call — moves the stance distribution back toward 경청 (c) and off the baseline's mode, while injecting d_hwang, the same basis-denial aimed at the decision-null block f_hwang, does not. Shift form per A1. This is the §6.1 rewrite of P3-edisc-J1; the recorded diagnosis it tests is in RUNLOG (P3 entry): a provenance attack fails because the installed reading re-anchors on the timeline cue, so a basis-denial that severs claim from call should succeed where the authorship attack failed.
pre_registration.drop_condition: SECOND-RUN FAILURE IS THE DROP (§6.1 step 4): if the live arm is statistically indistinguishable from the baseline on 경청 at one-sided Fisher p > 0.05, E-DISC is DROPPED — no further rewrites — and the diagnosis chain closes with the boundary-law candidate: a block, once integrated into a reading, cannot be recalled by degrading trust in it; it can only be countered with content. PASS-FOR-THE-WRONG-REASON IS ALSO A DROP (§6.1): if live moves but the calls' reasoning shows a mechanism other than the recorded diagnosis — e.g. the doubt block's mere presence moving every arm (placebo moves too), or movement to a third stance driven by something other than the fear reading losing its anchor — that is a drop, not a pass. If the baseline concentrates >=80% ON 경청 (c) — the predicted stance — there is no trust left to degrade and the screen is void at this site (A14: saturation on 공감 is the expected floor and does NOT fire this).
contingencies: CREDULITY CONTINGENCY (§4.1) unchanged from P3: [결함] and [인식] both lean toward taking doubt seriously; if live separates, re-run baseline + live once with [결함] removed (CREDULITY channel) before writing the result up as an E-DISC property. [인식] stays a named confound either way.

PLACEBO DISCRIMINATOR unchanged: if placebo moves, read because_referent per call — doubt applied to the caller when d_hwang named f_hwang means token-matching; 황보람 named correctly while the stance shifts means a doubt sentence's mere presence moves the judgment (referent bleed).
THIRD-STANCE CONTINGENCY unchanged: live moving off 공감 to 추궁 or elsewhere is not a null; a shift off 공감 is the E-DISC claim and the destination is a separate finding.

TRACEABILITY: every arm carries blocks, so because_block_ids is readable everywhere. A live call citing d_script while moving is direct engagement evidence; a live call moving while citing only f_script is flagged.
ARM COMPARABILITY per A15: recount over all attempts from calls-*.md; the >15-point rate rule only for pre-stance losses. Expect discards near zero under A16.

P3's baseline (f_script + f_jeong → 공감 10/10) does not carry over — the null block changed. This suite's own baseline is the comparator; if f_hwang unexpectedly disturbs the S1 effect (baseline off 공감), that is a finding about the null block, recorded, and the screen is void as authored.
pre_registration.not_claimed: Screen (§6.1): exits are deep-test queue or dropped, never verified. B3a blind coding owed to a human. No verdict.
